title: DCFC reveals new stadium's name, plan for community benefits - WDET 101.9 FM
content: Representatives from Mexicantown joined Mann for the announcement at The Mercado on Bagley St. Detroit City Football Club celebrated the naming of its new stadium with food, music, and artist renderings of the project. Club co-founder Sean Mann says the new grounds in southwest Detroit will be called AlumniFi Field. Representatives from Mexicantown joined Mann for the announcement at The Mercado on Bagley St. Mann says the next step in the process is to craft a community benefits agreement with the city and surrounding neighborhoods. He also says since the project is privately owned and financed, the club will pay property taxes on it. Mann says the goal is to finish the stadium and open it in time for the club’s 15th anniversary in 2027. He says he hopes fans and families will be able to enjoy the stadium for generations to come. “It’s obviously a great step forward for this club, and the city, and the sport in general.”.
